lines.text: Kelce's Super Bowl ring vanished in chili.
In April 2024, Jason Kelce hosted a live podcast in Cincinnati.
lines.say: In April twenty twenty four, Jason Kelce hosted a live podcast in Cincinnati.

lines.text: Students searched pools of Skyline Chili for rings hidden in socks.
One ring was a replica, and the other was his real one.
Kelce said on his podcast that he had legitimately lost it.
His theory was that a sock got kicked out and thrown away.
A metal detector failed, because the chili contains iron.
He guessed it was in a landfill near Cincinnati.
He filed a claim and planned to get a new ring.
That ring came from the Eagles' 41 to 33 Super Bowl win.

post.caption: Kelce's Super Bowl ring vanished in chili. In April 2024, Jason Kelce and his brother Travis hosted a live New Heights podcast show at the University of Cincinnati. Students searched pools of Skyline Chili for rings hidden in socks. One ring was a replica, and one was Jason's real Super Bowl ring. He said he had legitimately lost it, and guessed the sock was kicked out and thrown away. A metal detector failed because the chili contains iron. He filed an insurance claim. The ring came from the Eagles' 41 to 33 win in Super Bowl LII.
